Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by insisting on verifying whether the painting was attributed to “the Younger” before providing the death year, causing a repetitive, unproductive loop of attribution checks. Instead of directly identifying “the Younger” as Lorenzo Costa il Giovane and retrieving his death year (1583), the Planner fixated on attribution, leading to stagnation and failure to deliver the correct, straightforward answer.
